assetOnboardingSourceFile.description: Latest uploaded asset hierarchy file or spreadsheet containing the entity.

configurationLastUpdated.description: Indicates when this asset was last updated in the asset configuration

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

dataValidationRuns.description:
All {@link DataValidationRun}s created for this asset.
Should be created using {@link DataValidationRuleset#validate}.
They are sorted in descending order of creation date, i.e. the latest
{@link DataValidationRun} will be the first entry in
this array.

latestDataValidationRun.description:
The latest {@link DataValidationRun}. Also, the first
element in the {@link dataValidationRuns} array.

datasetPreparationRuns.description:
All {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}s created as a result of
calling {@link prepareMlDatasets} or {@link prepareMlDatasetsBatch}.
They are sorted in descending order of created date, i.e. the latest
{@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun} will be the first entry in
this array.

latestDatasetPreparationRun.description:
The latest {@link ReliabilityMlDatasetPreparationRun}. Also, the first
element in the {@link #datasetPreparationRuns} array.

datasetPreparationStatus.description:
Represents the current status of data preparation based on the {@link #datasetPreparationRuns}.
If there is a completed run, the status is COMPLETE. Otherwise, it is the status of the latest run.

acl.description: List of {@link AclEntry} entries governing who can read/update/remove Objs.

typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

locationHistory.description: The historical location/address for the asset.

location.description: The current location/address for this asset.

realTimeLocations.description: Real-time location data for a moving asset.

denormAncestors.description: Ancestors in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

denormDescendants.description: Descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

relativePositionHistory.description: The historical relative positions of this physical asset.

relativePosition.description: The current relative position of this physical asset.

measurements.description: Physical measurement series related to this asset.

pointMeasurements.description: Point measurement series for time-series metrics related to the asset.

events.description: {@link ReliabilityAssetEvent}s belonging directly to this asset.

childSensorRelations.description:
The {@link Sensor}s associated with this {@link PhysicalAsset}.

This field establishes the relationship between the physical asset and its associated sensors,
using a filter to only include sensors in the relation (where the type of relation is 'SENSOR').

assetClass.description: The {@link AssetClass} this asset belongs to.

hierarchyTemplateAssetId.description:
The id set by {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate} to identify this asset in relation to the template's hierarchy.
This id is unique within each hierarchy produced by a specific {@link AssetHierarchyTemplate} .

relDenormAncestors.description: All ancestors in the hierarchy throughout history.

currentRelDenormAncestors.description: All current ancestors in the hierarchy, excluding {@link Sensor}s.

currentAncestorsAndSelf.description: All current ancestors in the hierarchy and this asset.

relDenormDescendants.description: All descendants in the asset hierarchy throughout history.

currentRelDenormDescendants.description: Current descendants in the asset hierarchy, excluding {@link Sensor}s.

currentChildrenAndSelf.description: This field should be used instead of #currentRelDenormDescendants because {@link ReliabilityAssetHierarchyDenorm} isn't created for nodes without edges.

numCurrentDescendants.description: Number of current descendants in the asset hierarchy

currentChildren.description: The current direct children of this asset.

currentSensorHierarchicalRelations.description: Relations to {@link Sensor}s currently directly linked to this asset.

sensorHierarchicalRelations.description: Relations to {@link Sensor}s directly linked to this asset.

currentSensorDenormDescendants.description: Current descendants in the asset hierarchy that are {@link Sensor}s.

sensorRelations.description: All {@link Sensor}s ever clustered to this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

currentSensorRelations.description: Current {@link Sensor}s clustered to this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

depth.description: The depth of this asset in the hierarchy.

hierarchyClassification.description: A classification of what level of hierarchy this asset belongs to.

functionalLocation.description: A label for this asset which indicates the functional location/usage that this asset represents.

linked3DModel.description: The 3D model linked to this asset.

linked3DModelToDisplay.description: The 3D model linked to this asset, or the 3D model linked to the asset class if no 3D model is linked to this asset.

facilityRelations.description: All incoming {@link FacilityReliabilityAssetHierarchicalRelation}s, if any. Only relevant for the "top level" of the asset hierarchy.

currentFacilityRelations.description: Current incoming {@link FacilityReliabilityAssetHierarchicalRelation}s, if any. Only relevant for the "top level" of the asset hierarchy.

directWorkOrders.description: {@link WorkOrder}s belonging directly to this asset.

regionName.description: The name of the region this asset is related to.

members.description: List of {@link Member}'s linked to this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

documents.description: All the {@link AssetDocument}s associated with this asset.

facility.description: The ancestor {@link Facility} associated with this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

rootAsset.description:
Gets the ancestor root {@link ReliabilityAsset} associated with this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.
`currentRelDenormAncestors.(isRoot == true).distance` represents the depth of the ancestor.

parentAsset.description: Gets the direct parent associated with this {@link ReliabilityAsset}.

characteristics.description: Collection characteristic values associated with a given reliability asset.

assetImportanceLevel.description: The importance level of the asset, which is used to determine the asset's criticality.

currentModelRelations.description: All current model relations for this asset.

riskModelValidationRelations.description: All model validation relations for reliabilityRisk models for this asset.

currentReliabilityRiskModelRelations.description: All current model relations for reliabilityRisk models for this asset.

alerts.description: Alerts belonging to this asset and its descendant assets.

countOfLiveProjects.description: Count of projects that the {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation}s with status 'CHAMPION' belong to.

reliabilityRiskModelRelations.description: All model relations for reliabilityRisk models for this asset.

totalModelCount.description: Count of #currentModelRelations. Models type or status not considered. Used in the UI.

modelRelations.description: All model relations for this asset.

latestAlert.description: Most recent alert belonging directly to this asset

directAlerts.description: Alerts belonging directly to this asset.

mutedModels.description: Count of champion {@link ReliabilityMlModel}s that are muted.

countOfProjects.description: Count of projects that the {@link ReliabilityAssetToModelRelation}s belong to.
